LanguageData.PV_Profile_ClassicHaze_Desc: Authentic 3-tier Fog of War. The globe begins shrouded in the black unknown; explored terrain becomes Slate Haze; active radar/scout coverage reveals dynamic hostiles.
LanguageData.PV_Profile_TacticalSurveillance_Desc: Planetary geography is known, but dynamic hostiles and unvisited sites remain masked until within sensory envelopes.
LanguageData.PV_Profile_Omniscient_Desc: Vanilla spectator mode. Entire planetary surface and all incursion vectors are completely visible at all times.
LanguageData.PV_Touchdown_UnviableSector: Touchdown in unviable sector. Landfall must take place in an explored or accessible region.
LanguageData.PV_Dialog_Adopt_Desc: Select the sensory and fog-of-war rules for this world:
